title: Xanthe and the Parish
author: Theo Ashgrove
blurb: Casper Brightwater, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, has spent twelve years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
